parsed.answer: GET /v1/customers/{customerId}/accounts (operationId: listCustomerAccounts) — it returns every account held by the customer, including blocked accounts.

1. list customer accounts endpoint

operationId: listCustomerAccounts

Tags: Customers

- status (string, enum OPEN|BLOCKED, required): Whether the account can be used.
